name: General Assistant
description: General-purpose LLM assistant that uses whatever MCP tools the Nasiko gateway exposes to complete arbitrary tasks. Asks the user for missing information (TaskState.InputRequired) instead of guessing, and pauses for authorization (TaskState.AuthRequired) when a tool call needs approval it doesn't yet have — built to exercise the platform's end-to-end HITL implementation on a real, general-purpose agent rather than a fixed scenario. Its ask_human tool can also offer the user selectable single-select/multi-select options (with optional free-text custom input) instead of a bare free-text question.

skills.name: General Assistant
skills.description: Completes any task using the MCP tools available to it. Asks a clarifying question (InputRequired) when required details are missing, and pauses for authorization (AuthRequired) when a tool call needs approval it doesn't have yet — reply on the same task to resume either way. When the valid answers form a fixed set, it asks with selectable options (single-select or multi-select, optionally with a free-text "something else") instead of a bare free-text question.
examples: Schedule a call with the design team
Create a GitHub issue for this bug
What's on my calendar this week?

skills.name: HITL Input-Required Fixture
skills.description: Deterministic, dependency-free trigger that always returns TaskState::InputRequired with a fixed question — for smoke-testing the platform's HITL wiring without an LLM or MCP gateway.

skills.name: HITL Auth-Required Fixture
skills.description: Deterministic, dependency-free trigger that always returns TaskState::AuthRequired with a fixed authorization message — for smoke-testing the platform's HITL wiring without an LLM or MCP gateway.

skills.name: HITL Selectable-Options Fixture (Single-Select)
skills.description: Deterministic, dependency-free trigger that returns TaskState::InputRequired with a single-select question (three predefined options plus free-text custom input allowed) — for smoke-testing the selectable-options HITL extension without an LLM or MCP gateway.

skills.name: HITL Selectable-Options Fixture (Multi-Select)
skills.description: Deterministic, dependency-free trigger that returns TaskState::InputRequired with a multi-select question (four predefined options plus free-text custom input allowed) — for smoke-testing the selectable-options HITL extension without an LLM or MCP gateway.
